_help: Target: actor class to edit (empty = the pawn you control). TargetClassPath: optional full path of that class. PrimaryComponent: mesh whose bones are listed (empty = the Character's Mesh). Include/ExcludeComponents: mesh names. SameSkeletonOnly: also edit other meshes on the actor that share the primary mesh's skeleton. Hook: pose hook values for this game's exe (custom UE 4.26); delete the line if a game update breaks it.
